correctness.rationale: The stationary OU velocity is Gaussian with covariance Theta I. Generator identities solve the two X_1-V cross moments and the stationary variance; a forced scalar lag equation integrates to the displayed exact covariance. A positive prefactor governs r<gamma, a nonzero slower cyclotron sinusoid governs r>gamma, and an exact trigonometric amplitude gives the gamma/sqrt(2) critical endpoint. The proof handles every positive rate and every lag without extrapolating finite numerics. 436 independent computational comparisons passed.
